text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, this year's Derby was intense too... 
—Hey, what're you messing with your phone 
for?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking into it. That "Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe" thing you mentioned earlier. 
...Because <chrname> was great.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
They say there's a 'Representative 
Exchange Match' next month. And they're 
taking supporter sign-ups too... 
............I'm definitely joining.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Talk about fast on your feet!? ...Still, 
maybe that ain't bad, huh? I do wanna see 
what becomes of <chrname>, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(...<chrname> and the others are steadily 
generating excitement.)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(Draw in this heat and let it blaze. That 
blazing wind will become a tailwind to 
carry me to the world.)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Then I will too. Pour everything you can 
as the leader into everyone in 'Project 
L'Arc.'

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
First, in the upcoming Representative 
Exchange Match. We'll scale it up compared 
to last time and draw people in. More 
runners, more PR... spreading to the 
general public, too—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to arrange a race worthy of 
Team Japan at the "Representative Exchange 
Race"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race. Checking the reception for 
<chrname> mixed in with the cheers, I go to greet 
her in the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's move forward. To earn our ticket as 
Japan's representative in next month's 
Exchange Match. To make our dream of 
becoming the best in the world come true—
